title: Dxcufgb's Initiative Tracker
description: A small, tidy initiative order over the map instead of the big combat tracker: a slim horizontal or vertical row of every combatant's token, a now / next pill, or a semicircle with the current combatant in the centre, plus optional turn-order numbers on the tokens. Tokens slide into place as turns change, defeated combatants fade to grey, and every player sets up their own size, layout and colours.
